paragraphs: The M340d xDriv has been a mainstay of the 3 Series diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early G20/G21 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the G20/G21 and later the G20/G21, the M340d xDriv switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The M340d xDriv is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: The BMW B57 is a 3.0-litre twin-turbo diesel straight-six, fitted to the M340d xDrive from 2019 to 2024 (UK). This generation of engine is generally reliable, with no specific widespread failure pattern confirmed for this application. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every B57 rebuild.
